about: A place is keyed by what its pages read: the second head's word, with its epoch only while the word is stale, since only then does a page print it; the ledgers a fold reads, never the gate's, whose lines no fold reads; and, beside the coordinates its readers observed, the files a measure=lines region hands whole. Measured on the same copy with the new keys.

cases.name: the second head agrees again at a new epoch
cases.reach keys moved: 0 of 15 on second; bound and the root moved on placed, the copy's own readers landing between the two reads

red was: an act that paid for every place its neighbour left
